. the run takes place on sun, 18th oct. from cappagh gaa pitch (a83 y512). registration opens at 11.30am & run departs at 1pm; returning in approx. one hour. all profits from the event will be donated as usual to a local charity in the area. the relationship between religious faith and public life is perplexing. in some societies, even today, there is virtually no difference between the two. in other more secular societies, any expression of religious conviction is unacceptable in public. it is true of course that there is an appropriate distinction and even separation to be made, as indeed jesus does make today in the gospel. but on at least two issues, there is bound to be some crossover. religious faith informs our values and in society today policies and laws must be grounded, not in a particular faith certainly, but in values nevertheless. god's people strive for justice, peace and salvation. their only true happiness will be in god; apart from him, all is nothing! entrance antiphon : to you i call; for you will surely heed me, o god; turn your ear to me; hear my words. guard me as the apple of your eye; in the shadow of your wings protect me . responsorial psalm : give the lord glory and power. true love is always shown in deeds, not words! october is mission month. love – lord, i want to be your missionary to all the world. may i be a sign of your love for all people and may i show forth the living presence of god. sharing – lord, help me be a missionary wherever i am, make me a better person, more honest with myself, sympathetic to those who suffer and more willing to share with those who are hungry for bread and for god.

leighlin parish newsletter 25th october 2026 30th sunday in ordinary time a tear of hope. come as you are, that’s how i want you. come as you are, feel quite at home. close to my heart, loved and forgiven. come as you are, why stand alone? no need to fear, love sets no limits. no need to fear, love never ends. don’t run away, shamed and disheartened. rest in my love, trust me again. i came to calm sinners, not just the virtuous. i came to bring peace, not to condemn. each time you fail, to live by my promise. why do you think, i’d love you the less? come as you are, that’s how i love you; come as you are, trust me again. nothing can change, the love that i bear you. all will be well, just come as you are. contact details: fr pat hennessy
